foregroundService.title: Notification listening service
foregroundService.reason:
Notification listening service

This service needs to keep running in the background in order to:

  • Read system notifications in real time
  • Push to the client through Socket

SettingPanel.description: This function starts a local service for receiving and processing notification messages in the Android system status bar. Please make sure the port is not occupied.
SettingPanel.riskWarning: Risk warning: Turning this feature on will allow the app to read all your notification messages, which may contain sensitive information. Please use with caution.
SettingPanel.portRangeError: The port must be an integer between 1025 and 65535.
